nodes.label: Figures as Interfaces: Toward LLM-Native Artifacts for Scientific Discovery
nodes.author: Yifang Wang, Rui Sheng, Erzhuo Shao, Yifan Qian, Haotian Li, Nan Cao, Dashun Wang

nodes.label: LLM-Native Figures Concept
nodes.rationale: Data-driven artifacts designed from ground up to exploit LLM capabilities as core computational engine, maintaining bidirectional mapping between natural-language intent, analytical operations, and visual interactions

nodes.label: Nexus System Implementation
nodes.rationale: Proof-of-concept system for science of science domain implementing LLM-native figures with hybrid language-visual interface

nodes.label: Bidirectional Mapping Framework
nodes.rationale: Explicit mapping linking visual marks and GUI interactions to underlying analytical operations and data rows, enabling round-trips between visual and analytical representations

nodes.label: Data-Driven Artifact
nodes.rationale: Reusable composable unit capturing trajectory of states across one or multiple figures, coordination relationships, and exploration logic including manipulations and extensions

nodes.label: Multi-Agent LLM Engine
nodes.rationale: Coordinates Planner, Executor, and Evaluator agents operating at action-level granularity through plan-action-observation loop

nodes.label: Compositional Action Space
nodes.rationale: Atomic operations for data filtering, transformation, analysis, and visualization that serve as fundamental execution primitives

nodes.label: Science of Science Case Study
nodes.rationale: Demonstrates Nexus system exploring university innovation landscape through iterative data exploration with linked figures

nodes.label: Bidirectional Mapping Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Tests fidelity of analytical operations to visualization mapping (92.7% end-to-end accuracy) and visualization to analytical operations mapping (79.8% SQL generation accuracy)

edges.rationale: Both address implicit knowledge and reasoning structures that must be made explicit for AI systems
Both address autonomous planning and exploration in complex reasoning tasks

hyperedges.label: Human-AI Scientific Collaboration Paradigm
hyperedges.rationale: Three core concepts from Nexus system form integrated framework for mixed-initiative scientific discovery through provenance-aware interactive artifacts
